blocks.label: relationships
blocks.extractionHint: Keep the interactions between the characters and the player, promises made, and details they can bring up later. Use the Affinity panel for affinity; Heart Routes for the five route characters' stage, Trust and Pressure; and character profiles for supporting characters' Trust, Pressure and non-romantic relationship state, and all eight characters' Public Closeness. Keep the events here, without storing another current copy of those values or stages.

blocks.label: campus_schedule
blocks.extractionHint: Keep the current place and weather, the next bell or plans before closing, who might be here, and where people have agreed to go next. Use world time for the date and period; memory must not keep a separate clock.
